name: cool-progress
description: A slim animated band above the prompt: live progress bar with a position marker, a compact sub-agent panel with pixel mascots, model and estimated cost, and background-task rows with an animated terminal sign.

maxAgents.title: Max agent rows
maxAgents.description: Most sub-agents listed in the panel (two lines each); the rest collapse into '+N more'.

estimateSteps.title: Progress pace (steps)
estimateSteps.description: With no todo list the bar is an estimate: it reaches ~63% after this many model steps, then slows down.

agentEstimateSteps.title: Agent pace (steps)
agentEstimateSteps.description: Same estimate for each sub-agent's own bar.

mascotMap.title: Mascot map
mascotMap.description: Pin mascots by agent type or name: 'scout=crab,worker=robot,deep-thinker=wizard'. Others are matched by role keywords.

defaultMascot.title: Default mascot
defaultMascot.description: Mascot when no keyword matches: crab, robot, owl, cat, ghost, wizard, or a name from your sprites file.

spritesFile.title: Custom sprites file
spritesFile.description: Absolute path to a JSON file of your own pixel mascots (see README).

showCost.title: Show estimated cost
showCost.description: Show tokens and estimated API cost per agent.
